title: Notion Business to self-hosted AppFlowy
summary: AppFlowy is the closest open-source shape to Notion. Whether it pays off depends almost entirely on your seat count.

you_lose: Notion's AI features, which are a large part of what the Business tier is sold on
Public page publishing and the template gallery
Mature mobile apps — AppFlowy's are usable but noticeably behind
you_gain: Your documents in a Postgres database you can query and back up yourself
No per-seat cost, so adding people is free
Local-first editing that keeps working when the network does not
AGPL-3.0 licensing with no vendor able to change the terms on you

caveats: AppFlowy Cloud self-hosting is a multi-container stack (Postgres, Redis, GoTrue, MinIO). It is a real deployment, not a single binary.
Notion's import is one-way. Getting a large workspace out cleanly takes longer than the estimate if you have deeply nested databases.
The 10-hour migration figure assumes a workspace of a few hundred pages. Multiply it for a large one.
